note: Client projection of packauth:registry:environment, generated by scripts/build-openapi.mjs. Carries the variables a client reads; the full registry lives in the PackAuth repository.

variables.name: PACKAUTH_API_URL
variables.description: Which PackAuth to talk to. Unset means production, which is the safe default for a client and the dangerous one for a developer who meant to use the sandbox — hence the plane check.

variables.name: PACKAUTH_OPERATOR_TOKEN
variables.description: A PackAuth OPERATOR key (`pa_op_`), never a tenant key. Optional: the live smoke skips the cross-tenant read checks without it, loudly, because a check that quietly does nothing is indistinguishable from one that passed. Issued by scripts/provision-operator.mjs, expires in at most 90 days, and every read it performs is written into the read tenant's own audit stream.

variables.name: PACKAUTH_TOKEN
variables.description: The tenant API key. `pa_live_` on production, `pa_test_` on the sandbox plane. Sent as `Authorization: Bearer`.
